name: Account Access Problems
description: Customers report being unable to access or create accounts, sometimes alongside logout or lost favorites.

name: General Account Access Concerns
description: Customers describe account access concerns including suspected hacking, privacy worries, and lost playlists or liked songs.

name: Unable to Log In
description: Customers report login failures, rejected passwords, or being locked out of their accounts.

name: Unexpected or Continued Charges
description: Customers report being charged after cancellation, charged while the service does not work, or needing to pay for features.

name: General Billing Problems
description: Customers raise varied billing concerns, including plan approval, podcast ads, charges, and missing cashback offers.

name: Subscription and Premium Access Issues
description: Customers report subscription promotions ending early, missing premium benefits, or difficulty accessing paid plans.

name: Pricing and Paid Features
description: Customers object to premium prices, ads, and features that require payment.

name: Missing or Unavailable Music
description: Customers report missing songs or music that is unavailable or inaccessible.

name: Missing Song Lyrics
description: Customers report that song lyrics are missing or no longer available.

name: Podcast Access and Suggestions
description: Customers report trouble finding, accessing, or following podcasts and frustration with unwanted suggestions.

name: Poor Music Recommendations
description: Customers say music recommendations are poor, unwanted, or continue despite disabling them.

name: Music Search Problems
description: Customers report being unable to search for songs or get search results.

name: Download and Library Problems
description: Customers report downloads failing, disappearing, repeatedly downloading, or being difficult to store.

name: Offline Listening and Downloads
description: Customers report missing downloads or being unable to listen offline.

name: Objectionable or Excessive Ads
description: Customers complain about the amount or content of advertisements.

name: Other General Concerns
description: Customers raise miscellaneous concerns about cost, personal information, harm, or removed content.

name: Problems After App Updates
description: Customers say recent app updates made the app unusable or caused other problems.

name: Audio Quality and Sound Problems
description: Customers report poor audio quality, no sound, or difficulty changing sound quality.

name: App Crashes During Playback
description: Customers report that the app crashes on launch or while playing music, particularly after updates.

name: Playback and Bluetooth Device Issues
description: Customers report music stopping or device connections behaving unpredictably during playback.

name: General Playback Problems
description: Customers describe varied playback failures, including volume changes, connectivity issues, and interrupted songs.

name: Playback Problems After Updates
description: Customers report that updates prevent songs from playing or remove playback functions.

name: Support and Account Help Concerns
description: Customers express dissatisfaction with support or describe account, subscription, and listening-history problems.

name: Ads Disrupting App Use
description: Customers say frequent or loud ads interfere with using the app and listening to music.

name: Playback Controls and Song Selection
description: Customers report difficulty choosing, skipping, repeating, queuing, or seeking within songs.

name: General Usability and Permissions
description: Customers describe varied usability concerns involving permissions, unexpected playback, integrations, and app features.

name: Playlist and Library Navigation
description: Customers report difficulty viewing playlists, finding library music, or playing selected songs.

name: Usability Problems After Updates
description: Customers say updates made it harder to navigate songs or use playback controls.
